caption: The mission chooses an altitude: 400 km.
Add the Earth's radius: the spacecraft is 6,778 km from the centre of the Earth.
Gravity there is just strong enough to bend its path into a circle at 7.67 km/s.
Going round 42,600 km of circle at that speed takes 92.6 minutes.
92.6 minutes is under the 95-minute limit, so the requirement closes.
